title: Rusltareq/FedGov-IoT-IDS: Initial public release
abstract: Initial public release of the code accompanying this PhD research: a federated learning (FedAvg/FedProx/FedDyn) framework for IoT intrusion detection, and the ReputationManager smart contract for active on-chain governance.
